annotations.title: Compare roof plan variants (solar roof check)

description: Compare 2 to 4 variants of one house's solar roof check plan side by side, as the page's „Varianten vergleichen“ does: give links (plans you already have, e.g. from edit_roof), or link and variants, each the plan with a few edit_roof edits (a battery size or none, a roof face off or on, an e-car or a heat pump, an offer price). Answers a table with, per plan: modules, kWp, kWh a year with measured weather, own use (share of the roof's power used in the house), autarky, self-used, fed-in and grid kWh, days without the grid, euros a year at public rates, kWh by month, the payback (on the person's own offer where one holds for that plan's system, else on that plan's upper price-guide value), its link, and the difference to the first plan; plus the first plan's battery curve: what each further kWh of battery adds a year, and from about which size each kWh adds little; and `day_views`: the same three real days of the person's weather (sunny, cloudy, winter) for every plan, hour by hour (solar, consumption, from the sun, to and from the battery, to and from the grid), the page's day view. Appliances and a heating rod are variants too (edit_roof device). One weather fetch for all. Nothing is stored; each variant comes back as its own link. An example, not a quote; the only prices are each plan's price guide, a guide and never an offer.

link.description: One plan to compare variants of (with variants).

links.description: 2 to 4 solar roof check links of the same house; the first is the one the others are compared with (usually the person's plan).

items.description: A solar roof check link (https://pv.skysolar.de/dachcheck/#d=…), as plan_roof, edit_roof or the solar roof check page gave it.

variants.description: 1 to 3 variants of the plan in link, each the plan with a few edits: a battery size (household battery_kwh, 0 for none) or type (household battery_type), a face off or on (remove_face, restore_face), an e-car, a heat pump or its heating rod (household, device), a dishwasher, washing machine or dryer in the evening or with the sun (device { start }), an offer price (household offer_eur).

edits.description: edit_roof edits that make this variant from the plan in link, written exactly as for edit_roof (not find_similar, check_outline or search_again).

type.description: The edit's type; its fields as in edit_roof (roof_edit_help explains each).

name.description: A short name for the table, e.g. "no battery", "with north side", "with heat pump".
